Eathfarnham Castle.(From a Photograph by Mr. T. Mason.) In the troubled times, about 1641, the Archbishops grandson. SirAdam Loftus, had a garrison in the castle to protect Dublin from the in-cursions of the rebels, and an explosion of gunpowder then took placethere, which nearly terminated the career of an extraordinary geniuscalled ,Tohn Ogilby,- who was at that time Master of the Revels, and owner ^ Calendar of State Papers, Ireland, passim. • See notice in Dictionary of National Biography. 108 ROYAL SOCIETY OF ANTIQUARIES OF IRELAND. of a theatre in Dublin, and who subsequently published the first road-book to England, in a noble folio volume. Before the battle of llath-mines the castle, which was then occupied by the forces of the Parliament,was stormed and taken by the Duke of Ormonde.
